cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your shop keys for a moment. We ring the farewell bell together before I take them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because that bell rings all day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this will be the last time. Put your hand beside mine on the bell, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Both hands, please. Watching isn't completing the handover. On three, then you can put the keys down. One, two—

reason: Replace the abstract team slogan with a specific joint ringing instruction and a finite release condition; preserve B's actual wish to leave.
